title: A recording exists, or its facts changed
description: data of likho.recording.updated.v1; published by likho-api on NATS subject likho.recording.updated when a recording is made and whenever its source, name or attributes change. likho-search keeps these facts beside the recording's lines, so a search can be narrowed by campaign, agent, disposition, source or when the call happened.

source.description: Where the call came from: upload, api, or a connector's name such as ameyo

external_id.description: The caller's own id for the call (a dialer id); empty for an upload

call_time.description: When the call happened: the dialer's call time when known, else when the recording was made

attributes.description: Facts about the call: campaign, agent, disposition, ... (text values)
